name: blog-dev
description: Convenience runner only - each blog/* service is still its own independent project with its own dependencies.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n event-bus,query,moderation,posts,comments,auth,referrals,tutor,client -c blue,green,magenta,cyan,yellow,gray,red,orange,white "npm run dev --prefix blog/event-bus" "bash -c 'cd blog/query && ./venv/bin/uvicorn main:app --reload --port 4002'" "npm run dev --prefix blog/moderation" "npm run dev --prefix blog/posts" "npm run dev --prefix blog/comments" "npm run dev --prefix auth" "npm run dev --prefix referrals" "npm run dev --prefix tutor" "npm start --prefix blog/client"
